permits.summary: Kenyan national building law and Nairobi County development-control starting points for a new build, alteration or change of use.

items.title: Development permission / land-use review
items.when: Likely applicable to building work or a material change of use; the exact county process and supporting documents depend on the site and proposal.
items.source: Kenya Law — Physical and Land Use Planning Act

items.title: Building-plan and code review
items.when: Likely applicable before construction. The National Building Code, 2024 commenced on 20 February 2025; verify the current Nairobi submission route and project classification.
items.authority: Nairobi City County and relevant registered professionals

items.title: Construction project registration
items.when: Likely applicable after a construction contract is awarded; the NCA states that developers register projects and lists the current supporting approvals.

items.title: Completion and occupation clearance
items.when: Likely applicable before opening a completed or altered building; confirm inspection, accessibility, fire and occupation requirements for the approved plans.
items.authority: Nairobi City County and relevant safety authorities
items.source: Nairobi Planning and Development Management System

permits.summary: Ugandan building-control law and local Building Committee starting points for a mosque project in Kampala.

items.title: Planning and land-use review
items.when: Likely applicable before a building application, particularly where the proposal changes land use; confirm the site-specific pathway with KCCA.
items.authority: Kampala Capital City Authority and local physical planning professionals
items.source: NBRB — What you need to know about building permits

items.title: Building permit application
items.when: Likely applicable before building operations. Submission requirements depend on the class and scope and may include registered architect and engineer documentation.

items.title: Current building-control law review
items.when: Likely applicable throughout design and construction. Uganda amended the Building Control Act in 2026, so verify how the amendment affects the project before relying on earlier guidance.
items.authority: National Building Review Board and KCCA Building Committee

items.title: Occupation permit
items.when: Likely applicable before occupation after practical completion; the Building Committee examines conformity with approved plans and regulations.

items.title: Building regulations approval
items.when: Likely applicable to new building work and many material alterations or changes of use.

items.title: Fire risk assessment and precautions
items.when: Likely applicable while operating a place of assembly; duties depend on premises and management.
items.source: GOV.UK — Fire safety risk assessment for assembly premises

items.title: Annual fire inspection / permit pathway

permits.summary: Toronto-specific zoning, building-permit and occupancy starting points for a new, altered or converted place of worship.

items.title: Zoning and place-of-worship use review
items.when: Likely applicable before design is fixed. Confirm that the use and proposal comply with the site-specific zoning, overlays and applicable-law approvals.
items.authority: City of Toronto Planning and Toronto Building
items.source: City of Toronto — Zoning By-law 569-2013, Place of Worship

items.title: Building permit
items.when: Likely applicable to a new building, additions, material alterations or a change of use. Confirm submission scope and required qualified designers with Toronto Building.

items.title: Assembly-occupancy review
items.when: Likely applicable because Toronto lists places of worship under Group A assembly occupancy for building-permit administration; verify classification for the actual mixed uses.
items.authority: Toronto Building and project code professionals
items.source: City of Toronto — Building Permit Fees

permits.rights: Original mosque.build summary of linked City of Toronto public guidance; source content is not reproduced

permits.summary: URA planning and BCA building-control starting points for purpose-built or adapted religious premises in Singapore.

items.title: Planning permission and land-use review
items.when: Likely applicable to development, building work or a proposed change of use unless a stated exemption applies. Religious activities are normally directed to land zoned Place of Worship.

items.title: Place of Worship development controls
items.when: Likely applicable to a purpose-built place of worship. Confirm plot ratio, height, setbacks, parking, ancillary uses and site-specific controls through the current application.
items.authority: Urban Redevelopment Authority and appointed Qualified Person
items.source: URA — Place of Worship development-control handbook

items.title: Building and structural plan pathway
items.when: Likely applicable before carrying out regulated building works; an appointed Qualified Person should confirm plan approval, structural submission and permit requirements.

items.title: TOP or Certificate of Statutory Completion
items.when: Likely applicable before occupation after building works. BCA states a TOP or CSC is required for occupancy, subject to the applicable clearances and completion route.
items.authority: Building and Construction Authority and relevant technical agencies

permits.rights: Original mosque.build summary of linked Singapore government guidance; source content is not reproduced

permits.summary: Cape Town land-use, building-plan, inspection and occupancy starting points for new construction, alteration or change of use.

items.title: Land-use and zoning review
items.when: Likely applicable before a building submission where the proposed religious use or development is not already authorized by the property rights and zoning.
items.authority: City of Cape Town Development Management
items.source: City of Cape Town — Land use, planning and building services

items.title: Building-plan submission
items.when: Likely applicable to a new building, alterations, extensions or a change of use. Confirm the current submission documents and professional appointments with the City.
items.authority: City of Cape Town Development Management
items.source: City of Cape Town — Submit a building plan

items.title: Construction inspections
items.when: Likely applicable during approved work. The City guidance identifies commencement or trench, sewer installation and completion inspections; verify the project-specific sequence.
items.authority: City of Cape Town building inspectors and relevant professionals
items.source: City of Cape Town — Submit a building plan

items.title: Certificate of occupancy
items.when: Likely applicable before formal occupation after completion. Confirm approved-plan conformity, required certificates and final inspection with the City.
items.authority: City of Cape Town Development Management
items.source: City of Cape Town — Building plan applications

permits.summary: Dubai mosque-specific administration, building-permit and completion starting points; the competent authority varies by site and development zone.

items.title: Mosque project administration and consultant appointment
items.when: Likely applicable to a mosque construction project governed by Dubai Administrative Resolution 83 of 2020; verify land allocation, donor, consultant and IACAD requirements for the specific project.
items.authority: Islamic Affairs and Charitable Activities Department and competent development authority
items.source: Dubai Legislation Portal — Administrative Resolution 83 of 2020

items.title: Building permit and approved drawings
items.when: Likely applicable before construction. Confirm the competent licensing authority, current Dubai Building Code pathway and all project-specific no-objection requirements.
items.authority: Competent Dubai development and construction licensing authority
items.source: Dubai Legislation Portal — Administrative Resolution 83 of 2020

items.title: Building completion and handover
items.when: Likely applicable after approved construction and inspections. The exact completion-certificate route and prerequisites depend on the site authority.
items.source: Dubai Development Authority — Building Completion Certificate

permits.summary: Jakarta spatial-control, building approval and functional-worthiness starting points through the official SIMBG DKI system.

items.title: Spatial-plan and site eligibility review
items.when: Likely applicable before technical design and PBG submission; verify the current IRK/KRK and spatial provisions for the actual parcel and religious use.
items.authority: DKI Jakarta spatial planning and building authority
items.source: SIMBG DKI Jakarta — PBG and spatial-requirement portal

items.title: Persetujuan Bangunan Gedung (PBG)
items.when: Likely applicable before carrying out regulated building work. Confirm non-residential submission documents, technical review and professional responsibilities through SIMBG.
items.authority: DKI Jakarta building authority through SIMBG

items.title: Sertifikat Laik Fungsi (SLF)
items.when: Likely applicable before the completed building is used. The official portal distinguishes new and renewal SLF pathways and lists administrative and technical evidence.

permits.rights: Original mosque.build English summary of linked DKI Jakarta public guidance; verify terminology against current Indonesian source

permits.summary: DBKL planning, building-control, construction-monitoring and completion starting points for a mosque project in Kuala Lumpur.

items.title: Planning and development-order review
items.when: Likely applicable before building-plan approval; confirm land use, current Kuala Lumpur development controls and project-specific planning submissions.
items.authority: Dewan Bandaraya Kuala Lumpur planning authority

items.title: Building-plan approval and construction permits
items.when: Likely applicable before regulated construction, renovation, temporary building or demolition work. Confirm the submitting-person and current DBKL process.

items.title: Construction monitoring and CCC
items.when: Likely applicable through construction and completion. DBKL describes monitoring until the Principal Submitting Person issues the Certificate of Completion and Compliance.
items.authority: DBKL and appointed Principal Submitting Person

permits.summary: Auckland resource-consent, building-consent and completion starting points for a new or adapted public assembly building.

items.title: Resource-consent and site-constraint review
items.when: Likely applicable where the Auckland Unitary Plan or regional controls require consent; confirm zoning, earthworks, transport, water and other site-specific triggers.
items.authority: Auckland Council and relevant network authorities

items.title: Building consent
items.when: Likely applicable to new commercial or assembly building work and substantial alterations. Confirm exemptions, code pathway and required professionals with Council.
items.source: Building Performance NZ — Check if you need consents

items.title: Consent conditions and completion evidence
items.when: Likely applicable where resource-consent conditions require notices, monitoring or completion records; building completion requirements remain a separate Council pathway.
